description: Recto contains the title page for a book of dirges for the dead by Moshe b. Levi ha-Levi. It's not clear that this title itself is in his handwriting, however the rest of the page is filled with related jottings in his hand, and verso contains part of a dirge in his hand, probably for someone named Shemuʾel.
description_he: טקסט ספרותי בעברית. מוחזק בספריית קיימברידג'.
